reports.title: Bandwidth Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Bandwidth is providing guidance for the full year 2026 as follows (in millions, except per share amounts) based on current indications for its business, which are subject to change.

Revenue | $905 - $910
Adjusted EBITDA | $124 - $125
Non-GAAP earnings per share (1) | $1.73 - $1.79
(1) Assumes weighted average diluted share count of approximately 38.7 million in full year 2026.
